steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio** — it's the better deal.

Both listings are for the exact same product:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite**
* over-ear, closed back, wireless with ANC + transparency mode
* up to 40 hours battery with ANC on, USB-C fast charge
* Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g
* In the box: headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable

Here's the comparison:

|  | **A - Ottervale Audio** | **B - Brackmoor Sound** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | **$129.00** | **$161.00** |
| Rating | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| Availability / Shipping | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | Same |
| Returns | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty | Same |

**Why A:**
Everything except price is identical — same rating, same in-stock status, same free 3-5 day shipping, same 30-day returns policy, same 1-year warranty.

Ottervale Audio is **$32 cheaper** — about 20% less — for the same headphones with the same terms, so there's no reason to pay $161 to Brackmoor Sound.
